What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 4013:Laser sensor may be blocked, The sensor is blocked?
* 1.If the protective film on the panel is lifted up and will hinder the normal operation of the radar, please ensure that the protective film on the robot's top panel surface is removed.

* 2.Remove foreign objects blocking the radar.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Remove-foreign-objects.png

* 3.Please use cotton swabs and other flexible materials to wipe the radar transmitting and receiving holes.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/wipe-the-radar-transmitting-and-receiving-holes.png

1. The warping of the protective film will hinder the normal operation of the radar, so please make sure that the protective film on the surface of the top panel is removed.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/remove-the-protective-film.png

2. Remove foreign objects blocking the radar;

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Remove-foreign-objects-blocking-the-radar.png

3. Please use cotton swabs and other flexible materials to wipe the radar transmitting and receiving holes.

建议您先打开 eufy Baby app 连接设备，按上述路径进入设置；如果在界面中没有看到对应入口，请告诉我当前使用的 App 名称和版本，我再帮您进一步核对。

response.subject: Re: Your support request — S1 Pro 吸奶器
response.draft:
Hello,

Thank you for contacting us.

Thanks for reaching out and for including your order number — I understand the pump is charged but won't hold its charge, and it keeps cutting off while you're using it. That's frustrating, especially with a device you rely on.

For the S1 Pro (T8D04), a full charge takes about 1.7 hours using an adapter of at least 5V/1A, and non-compatible chargers may result in poor charging efficiency; the built-in charging protection stops charging once full. A full charge is expected to last roughly 2 hours, covering about 4–6 pumping sessions, and using the heating function reduces that. You can check the level by pressing any button on the hub — a red light means below 20% and a flashing red light means below 10% — or view it in the Anker eufy app. From the information so far I can't confirm what is causing the cut-off, so replacement eligibility isn't something I can confirm at this point.

Could you let me know which wall charger or adapter you used for charging, and its output rating? With that detail we can narrow down the cause, and if the cutting-off continues after charging with a compatible adapter, we can pass your case to a human specialist for review. [2] [3] [4]

Anker Support Team
